scope: Only the two already encoded actual30-control endpoints and original goal. No new endpoint, candidate, objective, weight, rollout, model inference or utility definition.
native_sum_semantics: CPU FP32 visual_MSE + FP32(0.1*proprio_embedding_MSE), with the unchanged native final-time reduction. Component totals exactly reproduce the prior CPU native objective costs. Displayed JSON scalars are promoted to double; summing them without FP32 rounding may differ in the last bits.

existing_score_gap_identity.definition: For each representation, predicted gap = true-future proxy gap + gap error; gap is candidate1 cost minus candidate0 cost, not physical reward. These are identities on already reported scores.
existing_score_gap_identity.interpretation: Original forecasts reverse the native true-future proxy preference, while that selected candidate happens to have higher measured30-control physical reward. Canonical forecasts recover the true-future proxy ordering more closely on this bank, and select the candidate with lower measured reward. This is not a causal mediation percentage and does not exclude all roles of forecast error in the full planner.

proprio_semantics.native_input: The wrapper passes state[:4], which contains hand position and normalized finger separation, not target-relative TCP error.
proprio_semantics.encoding: Per-channel dataset mean/std normalization, followed by learned Conv1d kernel_size1 mapping4 to20 (prop_mlp=false). The20-vector is repeated over256 visual patch positions; the native mean reduction averages these repeats. The scored proprio term is learned feature-space MSE, not raw four-channel MSE or Euclidean TCP distance.
proprio_semantics.metric_inference: Because the active projection is affine, its feature-space squared distance is a learned quadratic form in the normalized four-field difference; no weights were loaded to inspect that form. It need not preserve TCP-to-target distance ordering.
proprio_semantics.reward_distance: Reach-v2 reward uses norm(tcp_center-_target_pos); tcp_center is the midpoint of rightEndEffector/leftEndEffector sites, whereas raw proprio xyz is the hand body position. Reward does not compare against the expert endpoint or include the gripper channel in its distance.

goal_semantics.source: native separate-env expert final image/proprio; expert controls are archived but never provided to CEM
goal_semantics.not_exact_physical_target: The original goal is the full visual/proprio observation after100 expert controls, with actual TCP0.045805141413181566m from target. Success permits distance<=0.05; this is an achieved example state, not an exact target-coordinate encoding.

recompute_expression: For each k in [visual,proprio], d_k=(torch.from_numpy(goal[k])-torch.from_numpy(truth[k])).pow(2).mean(dim=tuple(range(2,truth[k].ndim)))[-1]; use CPU float32 and torch.set_num_threads(4); total=d_visual+0.1*d_proprio.
